top_signals.title: Anthropic’s $1.5 trillion IPO in doubt as AI sell-off spooks investors
top_signals.summary: Anthropic’s blockbuster $1.5 trillion (£1.1 trillion) stock market listing could be delayed or forced into a dramatic valuation cut after a brutal Wall Street sell-off left investors questioning the price tag on one of the world’s most valuable AI firms.
